title: NSTAR Electric Company d/b/a Eversource Energy (“Eversource” or the “Company”) is filing herewith a petition with the Energy Facilities Siting Board (the “Siting Board”) pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3 seeking individual and comprehensive zoning exemptions from the operation of the Town of Plymouth Zoning Bylaw and the Zoning By-Law of the Town of Wareham in connection with the expansion of Eversource’s West Pond Substation located at 0 Federal Furnace Road in Plymouth and Tremont Substation located at 4 North Carver Road Extension in Wareham (together, “Substation Expansions”).

Attached for filing in the above referenced docket on behalf of NSTAR Electric Company d/b/a Eversource Energy is a petition pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3 seeking individual and comprehensive zoning exemptions from the operation of the Town of Plymouth Zoning Bylaw and the Zoning By-Law of the Town of Wareham in connection with the expansion of Eversource's West Pond Substation located at 0 Federal Furnace Road in Plymouth and Tremont Substation located at 4 North Carver Road Extension in Wareham. In addition to the petition, included in this filing are cover letter to the EFSB; Attachments A through R to the Petition and Notices of Appearances of Counsel.
